payload.description:
As an operator, I want the existing command worker to remain deployable while the new platform is validated, so that parallel migration does not interrupt current workloads.

Feature: Isolated command-worker migration
  Scenario: The portable worker runtime is introduced
    Given the existing Celery command worker remains the active production path
    When the new runtime and AWS service are built and deployed separately
    Then existing Celery entrypoints and infrastructure remain unchanged
    And the new service uses isolated queues, images, configuration, and resource names
    And cutover requires an explicit future decision
payload.title: Legacy command execution remains deployable during migration
